published_source_statements.text: | **What cooling does the configured machinery need on its ambient-pressure raft outside the vacuum?** | aircraft thermal engineering — ducting, coolant loops and bay ventilation remain unpriced |

3. **An aircraft thermal engineer.** *"The configured drives and plant sit on an ambient-pressure
   raft outside the vacuum. What ducting, coolant loops and ventilation do their duty cycles need,
   and what does that cooling system weigh at the working altitude?"*
The ground-plant comparator used in this plan is hardware with supplied cooling, matched by input power; it is not a complete airborne-system estimate.

The first-generation sealed-cell budget retains the cryogenic plant. Ducting, coolant loops and bay ventilation for the current ambient-pressure machinery
layout remain unpriced. The thermal analysis exists; the cooling installation's mass is still open.

rows.requirement: Match the actual complete machinery installation
rows.quantity: configured drives/plant, raft boundary and support inclusion
rows.prospective_method: Record the actual matched installation and included/excluded thermal supports. The public ambient-pressure raft description is scope context, not a selected or demonstrated hardware architecture.
rows.rejection_condition: A conceptual drawing or core machine substituted for a complete observed installation, unpriced support silently omitted or hardware selected by this paper.

rows.requirement: Match published duty and state boundaries
rows.quantity: operating episode, startup/restart/standby and ambient state
rows.prospective_method: Trace the existing duty/state questions to configuration-bound records for the thermal installation; unavailable histories remain missing, with no cycle/temperature/pressure assumption supplied.
rows.rejection_condition: Different operating or ambient states combined, a single nominal point credited as a complete duty record, or a new duty capability inferred.

rows.quantity: matched boundary streams and source/sink identities
rows.prospective_method: Record applicable raw heat-rejection observations for the same configured episode and identify boundaries; no heat, power or flow is evaluated or estimated here.
rows.rejection_condition: Input-power match called measured heat rejection, missing stream assumed zero, or a heat-balance estimate supplied as observation.

rows.quantity: installed routes, connections and inclusion boundaries
rows.prospective_method: Record actual duct/support configuration and its inclusion/custody evidence; the source says these supports remain unpriced. No routing, size or design is selected.
rows.rejection_condition: Absent ducting treated as complete support, a proposed layout selected, or drawing geometry credited as thermal performance.

rows.quantity: configured loop, interfaces, hardware and inventory boundary
rows.prospective_method: Record the actual loop/support inventory and interfaces on the matched installation; keep hardware and operating inventory boundaries explicit without specifying a coolant or heat-exchanger architecture.
rows.rejection_condition: Unspecified loop or supplied ground cooling treated as airborne completion, support/fluid omitted or a hardware family selected here.

rows.quantity: configured bay/air-path inclusion and matched operation
rows.prospective_method: Record actual bay ventilation configuration and applicable observations under the same duty/ambient state; no ventilation rate, capacity or operating assertion is supplied.
rows.rejection_condition: A rendered bay or open space credited as observed ventilation, mismatched operation or an invented ventilation requirement/capacity.

rows.quantity: installed support bill, included inventory and observed mass
rows.prospective_method: Record actual complete included supports and mass custody with the installation boundary. Member-census drawing/bill quantities retain their existing limited scope; this paper does not extend or recalculate them.
rows.rejection_condition: Existing structure bill or core plant comparator substituted for complete cooling installation, unknown counterpart treated as zero or a new mass estimate supplied.

rows.quantity: ground comparator state, supplied support and airborne inclusion
rows.prospective_method: Retain the source statement that the ground comparator has supplied cooling and is matched by input power; it is not a complete airborne-system estimate or matched thermal-installation observation.
rows.rejection_condition: Supplied ground infrastructure omitted or transferred as an airborne installation, input power treated as heat load or comparator mass/performance recalculated.

rows.quantity: source assertion, reachable artifact identity and scope
rows.prospective_method: Preserve the published assertion and documented locator search. Until an applicable current artifact is identified, its installation result remains unavailable rather than inferred or regenerated.
rows.rejection_condition: An asserted analysis called a located result, filename match called installation applicability, the scoped search claimed exhaustive, or a missing result invented.

rows.quantity: raw custody, calibration, matched states and uncertainty
rows.prospective_method: Record any actual calibration/uncertainty provenance associated with matched observations; no calibration, band or physical evidence is supplied by this paper.
rows.rejection_condition: A source assertion or model value substituted for calibrated observation, uncertainty assigned without a record or missing quantity set to zero.

rows.requirement: Keep thermal acceptance and assigned owner unresolved
rows.quantity: adopted applicability decision and accountable owner
rows.prospective_method: The public thermal-engineer role is a requested evaluator. Assigned acceptance owner and adopted criterion/decision remain unknown; no safety, adequacy or physical acceptance assertion is made.
rows.rejection_condition: Requested discipline treated as assigned acceptance authority, repository signature accepted as thermal qualification or a numerical criterion selected here.

missing_semantics: Unavailable actual configuration, heat rejection, complete support mass, calibration and adopted acceptance are null/UNKNOWN; assigned owner null/UNASSIGNED. A source assertion and scoped coverage gap are retained together.
scope: Thermal-installation evidence only; no nitrogen fraction/production, component/source-mass comparison, architecture/hardware selection, numerical criterion, safety assertion, new estimate, solver/test, source regeneration or remote/contact action.
